findings.detail: services/pm-daemon.js numEnv() uses `v > 0` so 0 falls back to the 600s default. Spec suggested grace=0 for S1 instant-claim; not achievable without editing shipped code. Workaround in test: grace=1 + sleep 2. No fix per spec: hardening logged for r3+.
